contentText:
Ella Langley’s presence in the top 10 remains strong, as does Morgan Wallen’s, while Taylor Swift, Stella Lefty, Ariana Grande and Olivia Dean help round out the rest of the top 10.

Tetris Kelly: This is the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 for the week dated Aug. 22. Still at 10 is “Be Her,” while “Man I Need” is back in the top 10. “Dracula” is locked at eight. “So Easy” is up to seven. So is “I Can’t Love You Anymore” to six. Ariana falls to No. 5. “Boston” rises to four. “Been By Now” at last week’s spot. As Swift is back to two. Now grabbing an 18th week at No. 1 is “Choosin’ Texas.”
